RenoiseScriptingTool.Author: ramiforms
RenoiseScriptingTool.Name: Transposition Shortcut Bar
RenoiseScriptingTool.Description: Adds a small bar of note transposition shortcut buttons (+1, -1, +12, -12, +N, -N) for the current pattern selection, shown only while the Edit (pattern editor) screen is active. Toggle it via View > Transposition Shortcut Bar. Tested with Renoise 3.5.4.
